headline: Island Fronts Surge; Attrition Lines Hold
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the contested island sectors have produced a fresh wave of ownership changes while the massive attrition corridors continue to bleed without territorial shift. Farranac Coast logged three captures in the past two hours, the latest at 20:43 UTC around Scythe, Terra and Mara, raising its 24‑hour flip total to twelve. Fishermans Row recorded four flips in the same window, most recently at 19:42 UTC near Fort Ember, Hangman's Court and Arcadia, pushing its daily tally to eleven. Tempest Island added six captures over the last six hours, the newest at 18:36 UTC at Blackwatch, Isle of Psyche and Surge Gate, for a 24‑hour total of fifteen. Lykos Isle registered three new turnovers in the past six hours, the latest at 16:10 UTC near Fort Guile and The Squall, keeping its day‑long activity at twenty‑five. Godcrofts saw two fresh flips at 17:27 UTC around Lipsia and Argosa, bringing its 24‑hour count to eleven, while Stlican Shelf recorded three captures since 18:52 UTC at Fort Hoarfrost. Dead Lands, though quiet in the last two hours, remains the bloodiest sector with roughly 2,100 Colonial and 2,300 Warden casualties in the latest two‑hour window and four flips over the past day. Meanwhile the high‑casualty belts — Weathered Expanse, Callahans Passage, Kings Cage, Marban Hollow, Loch Mor, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle — show accelerating losses on both sides with no change in strategic‑base ownership, which still favors Colonials on the western and southern arcs and Wardens to the north and east.
